With over a decade of hands-on experience in data privacy and international data protection, my professional journey reflects a strong dedication to advancing privacy compliance and operational excellence across complex global environments. My approach to privacy and operations management combines robust project and financial management skills with a collaborative “hybrid” expertise that integrates digital, creative, and data-driven personalization backgrounds. I have developed training programs, mentored teams, and driven cultural change to embed privacy-centric mindsets within dynamic, fast-paced environments.

This holistic experience, coupled with my practitioner certifications and forward-looking mindset, uniquely positions me to contribute to the IAPP community as a Fellow of Information Privacy. I am committed to advancing privacy standards, supporting innovation, and guiding organisations through evolving regulatory landscapes with clarity and confidence.

Counsel, this role is responsible for developing and taking ownership of key aspects of the firm's operational and
commercial data protection programme.
The Data Protection Specialist will be a trusted adviser to partners, lawyers and business services teams, helping the

technical expertise with practical problem-solving and relationship management, working closely with stakeholders
across the business to ensure data protection is effectively embedded into decision-making, procurement, technology,
supplier management and client engagements.
You will take ownership of significant areas of the firm's data protection programme, with particular responsibility for
supplier management, client and supplier contractual requirements, data protection due diligence, international data
transfer governance, auditing and wider regulatory compliance activities. You will help ensure that data protection is
effectively embedded into business processes, commercial decision-making and risk management activities. You will
take ownership of key workstreams, driving activity forward, identifying improvements and implementing practical, riskbased solutions that support the firm's strategic and operational objectives.
This role can be based in any of our regional offices.
The activities

identifying clients to be notified).
• Responding to regulatory queries.

• Responding to data subject rights requests as a third-line support with support from the Senior Regulatory &
Compliance Solicitor and the Senior Data Protection Specialist.

and consent, providing pragmatic, risk-based advice supporting business objectives.

rectification and erasure requests, reviewing disclosures and advising on exemptions where appropriate.

handling, sharing and disclosure of personal data in internal investigations, and ensuring compliance with UK
GDPR principles including proportionality, data minimisation, confidentiality and appropriate access controls.

Supplier management

Client-side contracts

Internal auditing and reporting

and other departments to implement resulting corrections.

• Reviewing and maintaining data protection content within the firm's risk register, identifying and escalating key
data protection risks.

• Conducting root cause and statistical analysis regarding data incidents and developing and implementing
corrective actions.
Internal departmental support

earners and Partners. 
749185328_1 3 www.mills-reeve.com
• Supporting employee rights request responses, including reviewing disclosures and advising on exemptions
where appropriate.
• Providing data protection input into internal investigations to support lawful handling, sharing and disclosure of
personal data.
Governance records

necessary.
Culture and awareness
• Supporting the Senior Data Protection Specialist in promoting a strong data protection culture across the firm.
The person

commercial data protection, ideally gained within a law firm, professional services business or similarly regulated
environment.
You will combine strong technical knowledge with sound commercial judgement. You will have the confidence to apply
your knowledge in a pragmatic, risk-based way. You will enjoy working independently, taking ownership of significant
areas of responsibility and driving matters through to completion.
You will have experience operating within a complex organisation where data moves across multiple systems, teams,
processes and third-party providers. You will be comfortable understanding and analysing complex data flows and
advising on the practical implications of business, technology and procurement decisions. You have a focus on noncontentious data protection (contracts, supplier management, international data transfers), and can assist with
responding to, and advising a range of internal stakeholders on, data subject rights, incidents, supplier and client-side

Given the responsibilities of this role, it is likely that your background and experience will include:

What is the role?

Head of Data Protection Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance shall lead the Data Protection Function that is responsible for developing, implementing, embedding and maintaining a data protection control and oversight framework for Howden's UK Broking (including its Specialty and Retail Pillars) and UK Reinsurance Divisions. The framework must be pragmatic, risk based and suitably robust to support Howden's UK Broking and UK Reinsurance entities to meet applicable data protection legislation, including the UK Data Protection Act, but also any other applicable legislation in territories where those entities operate. The framework must also align to and complement Howden Group's overarching Data Protection framework, governance and policy. 





What will you be doing?



Oversight & Change

Work closely with Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance senior leadership to develop and drive a data protection strategy that is aligned to the operating model and strategies of those businesses, promoting and supporting consistency of approach and application as much as practically possible. 
Develop and maintain an annual Data Protection Plan setting out the resources needed to deliver the projects and activities to be undertaken by the function, which shall be aligned to and support the regulatory expectations and objectives of the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses (which may include their overseas operations). 
Support in developing and maintaining a data protection risk and control framework, including data protection policy, processes, procedures, controls and monitoring.
Implementing a data protection horizon scanning process, ensuring any new or changing legislation is identified and implemented by expected timeframes.

Establish and maintain an effective data protection risk identification and escalation process across all Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses, ensuring swift and timely mitigation or management of risks and breaches. 
Develop, maintain and promote the consistent use of data protection tooling.
Continually raise awareness of data protection and ensure adequate programme of data protection related training to employees.
Oversee and manage any reporting to and interaction with data protection supervisory authorities, including the Information Commissioner's Office.
Ensure that all Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses have the correct data protection registrations and licences.
Support in embedding a data protection by design approach within Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses. 
 

Stakeholders

Key senior leadership across the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses to ensure a strong understanding of their current and future strategies, business models and objectives, to proactively pre-empt and recognise the data protection support they will require.

Key information security leadership and functions, to ensure a clear understanding of information security processes and controls, and how these dovetail and work alongside data protection controls and risk mitigants.
Internal Control Function Heads across the first, second and third line of defence, to develop an aligned and complementary risk, control and assurance framework, and to support addressing remedial actions.
Group Head of Data Protection and wider group data protection functions to support an alignment of approach, ensure consistent upward escalation and reporting and to share best practice and common risks and issues.

Supporting compliance with the UK Data Protection Act, the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), other Data Protection Laws and the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR).

Support in the development and on-going reporting of KRI and KCIs that feed into the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance risk management framework and, where relevant, Howden Group risk management framework and ERICCA. 
Having regard to the risk associated with processing operations and taking account of the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing
Prioritising focus on the more risky activities, e.g. where special category (sensitive) personal data is processed, or where the potential impact on individuals could be damaging;
Establishing clear points of contact for all BAU data protection queries from Howden's UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses with regard to potential complaints and breaches, ensuring that data subject rights' requests accurately handled
Making available data protection resources, policies, procedures, guidance, training material and points of contact information in a way that is easily accessible.
 

Team management

Develop and maintain a function with the appropriate blend of skill, experience and knowledge to deliver the data protection support and oversight required by the Howden UK Broking and UK Reinsurance businesses.
Implement an approach to employee development which enables employees to enhance their data protection, industry and Howden knowledge, experience and skill set.
Provides visionary leadership by fostering a culture of employee engagement and role modelling, encouraging and rewarding essential behaviours and maintaining a high level of personal and professional confidence

Identifies and hires talent
